configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Default development build: unoptimized, assertions active everywhere.

configurePresets.name: test-opt
configurePresets.description: Optimized (-O3) test run: wengine_test_assert (-UNDEBUG) keeps every assert() and its side effects alive despite -DNDEBUG from the build type.

configurePresets.name: bench
configurePresets.description: Benchmark build: -O3 -DNDEBUG (GCC Release defaults), no test assertion policy applied to bench_* targets. Effective flags are echoed at configure time and recorded in build-bench/CMakeCache.txt (CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE) and compile_commands.json.
